title: Sen. Murkowski Visits Coast Guard Rescue Crews in Kodiak
description: Sen. Lisa Murkowski talks with Kodiak-based Coast Guard air station helicopter rescue crews, members from Marine Safety Detachment Kodiak and Communication Station Kodiak during her visit to Kodiak Feb. 19, 2011. Murkowski was in Kodiak to visit air station rescue crews to commend them for their rescue efforts of more than 14 fishermen in the past several weeks. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Sara Francis.
keywords: Kodiak, Marine Safety Detachment, Sen. Lisa Murkowski, Sara Francis, helicopter, Coast Guard, Alaska
